headline: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
context: The New Yorker 's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.
